block-guide:
CORE/CODE Program code or command lines shown as written, in a monospace font, spaces and line breaks kept. No syntax colouring and no language setting. MARKUP (checked in the editor) 
<?php
if ( $a < $b && $b > 0 ) {
	echo '<p class="note">Hello</p>';
}
$list = [1, 2];
SPECIAL CHARACTERS (what the editor saves) < -> < always. A "<" before a letter is refused by these tools unless it is a closed tag, and a real tag here would become markup, not visible text. & -> & so that "<" written in the code itself stays visible as written. [ -> [ the editor writes it so a [shortcode] in the code is shown, not run. > may stay ">" or be ">"; both are valid. Quotes stay as they are. Line breaks and tabs are real newlines and tabs inside ; never
or  . Everything between and is shown: start the code right after . OPTIONS align: "wide" only. Colours, font size and padding follow the general class rules; the theme already sets a background, a monospace font and padding. CHECK Open the page: the code shows with its "<" characters and indentation; reopen the editor: no invalid-content notice.
